SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, qm.NAME as MEMBER_NAME, q.TITLE, q.CASE_TYPE, q.STATUS, q.CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ANSWER WHERE QUESTION_ID = q.QUESTION_ID) as ANSWER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_ID = q.QUESTION_ID AND REF_TYPE = 'QUESTION') as FILE_COUNT FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER qm ON q.MEMBER_ID = qm.MEMBER_ID
AND q.CASE_TYPE = #{caseType}
AND q.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%'
ORDER BY q.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, qm.NAME as MEMBER_NAME, q.CASE_ID, q.TITLE, q.CONTENT, q.CASE_TYPE, q.ASSIGNED_LAWYER, q.STATUS, q.CREATED_AT, q.UPDATED_AT, att.ATTACH_ID, att.ORIG_NAME, att.SAVE_PATH, att.FILE_SIZE, att.MIME_TYPE FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER qm ON q.MEMBER_ID = qm.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT att ON q.QUESTION_ID = att.REF_ID AND att.REF_TYPE = 'QUESTION' WHERE q.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_QUESTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_QUESTION ( QUESTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, CASE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CASE_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title}, #{content}, #{caseType}, 'OPEN', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUESTION SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CASE_TYPE = #{caseType}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND STATUS NOT IN ('ADOPTED', 'CLOSED')
